id.description: A UUID string identifying this logs alert configuration.

pagerduty_region.description: PagerDuty service region, us or eu. Defaults to us.

pagerduty_routing_key.description: The 32-character integration key of an Events API v2 integration on the PagerDuty service. Required when type is pagerduty.

pagerduty_severity.description: Incident severity for PagerDuty. One of critical, error, warning, info. Defaults to critical.

slack_channel_id.description: Slack channel ID. Required when type is slack.

slack_channel_name.description: Optional Slack channel name used for display.

slack_workspace_id.description: Slack workspace integration ID. Required when type is slack.

type.description: Destination type. Use slack, webhook, teams, or pagerduty. Slack requires slack_workspace_id and slack_channel_id. Webhook and teams require webhook_url. PagerDuty requires pagerduty_routing_key.

webhook_url.description: Required when type is webhook or teams.
